fallback_word.definition: A Hawaiian word that means hello, goodbye, and love all at once.
fallback_word.example: We said aloha to everyone when we got off the plane.

words.definition: The word you use to tell someone the reason why.
words.example: I wore my boots because it was raining.

words.definition: Someone you like to be with and who is kind to you.
words.example: My friend saved me a seat at lunch.

words.definition: Every single time, never missing one.
words.example: I always brush my teeth before bed.

words.definition: One more of the same thing.
words.example: Can I have another book to read?

words.definition: An idea in your head. It is also the past tense of think.
words.example: I thought the movie was funny.

words.definition: All of them, each and every one.

words.example: A little bird landed on the fence.

words.definition: Very pretty and nice to look at.
Something you did not know was coming.
words.example: The trip to Hawaii was a big surprise!
